title: enchantconfirm
summary: MSUI now routes BIND_ENCHANT and REPLACE_ENCHANT through the shared Benilla StaticPopup lifecycle and fully rule-owned geometry: showAlert widens the dialog to 420, displays the centered-left 64x64 alert icon, preserves the centered 290-wide GameFontHighlight message, dynamically sizes from the 72px floor, seats the two 128x20 buttons from the text anchor chain, and participates in the two-slot y=128/+8 stack. EnchantConfirmUiLaw returns the scaled frame and child rectangles; the renderer does not construct the frame geometry. Okay/Yes invokes the existing exact item-target bind or replace flow; Cancel/No/Escape only hides because neither Benilla entry defines OnCancel. CURRENT_SPELL_CAST_CHANGED-equivalent targeting changes clear both popup types. Focused and full interface-wire checks cover the geometry, source wiring, shared lifecycle, and no-invented-opcode contract.

openItems.text: Implemented but needs live-session verification. MSUI now implements the complete build-5875 item-target enchant confirmation path: exact eligibility, bind, and replacement gate order; exact DBC names and flags; exact popup strings/buttons; bag and paper-doll interception; same-cast item packet; and no invented replacement opcode.
The enchanting confirmation renderer still constructed the scaled popup ScreenRect directly after receiving its logical layout.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: EnchantConfirmUiLaw now owns scaled frame construction and aliases the shared StaticPopup top seat. Focused ItemEnchant and full interface clinical suites pass.
